notes.title: New game Herdling
notes.content:
After working for more than two years in the dark, Okomotive is proud and happy to present their brand new IP and upcoming game «HERDLING».

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33976734/f83796f984d94a394296f2ce93285e7acc0e8bec.png

Herdling is a new adventure from Okomotive, creators of the atmospheric and acclaimed FAR games, and Panic, publishers of Firewatch.

Head out on a grand alpine expedition with a herd of loveable beasts, as you ascend a mountain path, encounter eerie dangers and surprising obstacles, and forge your way to the mystery at the summit.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tUEcKBVzhQg
Features:

 Guide, protect, and fall in love with a motley herd of Calicorns
Traverse stunning mountainscapes, fog-wreathed forests, snowy plateaus, and forgotten valleys
Hone your herding skills as you navigate a wide range of challenges, threats, and light environmental puzzles
Feel the rush of the mountain air alongside your herd in exhilarating stampede sequences
An emotional, wordless tale of trust, survival, and companionship during a great crossing through a fallen world

Release date: 2025
Platforms: PC & Consoles
 Visit herdling.game 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3047750/Herdling/

notes.title: FAR: Changing Tides v1.2.0 – Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello folks!

Just wanted to provide some brief notes for the changes made in the recent patch for FAR: Changing Tides. We’ve made a few control/interface changes based on player feedback. Please see below:

FAR: Changing Tides v1.2.0

Interface/Experience

•	Implementation of arrow key control for the protagonist 
•	Keyboard layout to be set to either QWERTY or AZERTY.
•	Default camera can now be adjusted 
•	Minor revisions to credits, including the ability to press a key/button to bypass

Gameplay

•	Increased the sensitivity when climbing ladders 
•	Improved physics/collisions 
•	Minor optimization of key systems

Enjoy!

notes.title: FAR: Changing Tides Giveaway - Win an RTX 3070
notes.content:
To celebrate the announcement of FAR: Changing Tides we have decided to christen this voyage! But instead of champagne, we have teamed up with Cooler Master and Hyper X to give away some amazing prizes.


The winner will get a custom-wrapped EG200 Graphics booster with an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 8GB GDDR6 Graphics Card to help them appreciate the world of FAR in greater clarity.


But that's not all, two runners-up will have the chance to win:

An Alloy Elite 2 Keyboard from HyperX
Custom FAR: Changing Tides T-shirt
Custom FAR: Changing Tides Pin
Custom FAR: Changing Tides Tin
Pulsefire Dart Wireless Gaming Mouse from Hyper X
Custom FAR: Changing Tides T-shirt
Custom FAR: Changing Tides Pin
Custom FAR: Changing Tides Tin

To win all you have to do is head over to our Gleam competition here and follow the steps provided. (T&C's can be found on the competition page.)


Make sure you sign up with as many options to increase your chances of winning.


The competition will close on Thursday the 22nd of July at 23:59 GMT!


If you want to keep up to date with all the FAR news, then head to www.farchangingtides.com and sign up for our Newsletter, and follow us on Twitter, Facebook and Instagram.


Good Luck!
